app.name: Ultrakey
permissions.accessibility.title: Enable Accessibility for Ultrakey
permissions.accessibility.body: Ultrakey remaps your keyboard by watching input events system-wide. Turn on Accessibility access so it's allowed to do that.
permissions.accessibility.path: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility
permissions.accessibility.path.legacy: Open System Preferences → Security & Privacy → Accessibility
permissions.accessibility.checkbox_hint: Find Ultrakey in the list and turn on its checkbox.
permissions.accessibility.locked_hint: If the checkbox is grayed out, click the lock icon and enter your password first.
permissions.out_of_sync.title: Ultrakey's permissions look out of sync
permissions.out_of_sync.body: macOS still shows Accessibility as enabled, but Ultrakey isn't actually receiving input events. Removing and re-adding the app in System Settings usually clears this up.
permissions.out_of_sync.manual_steps:
1. Remove {0} from the Accessibility list.
2. Relaunch {0}.
3. When {0} reappears in the list, check its box again.
engine.fatal.tap_create_failed.title: Ultrakey couldn't start listening to your keyboard
engine.fatal.tap_create_failed.body: Creating the system event tap failed even though permission is granted. Ultrakey will close now — please follow the recovery steps before reopening it.
dev.not_app_bundle.title: Running outside an app bundle
dev.not_app_bundle.body: This build was launched with `tauri dev`, so macOS grants permissions to its parent process rather than Ultrakey. Permission-related features can't be verified this way — build and sign a `.app` bundle with `tauri build` instead.
menu.launch_on_login.failed: Couldn't turn on Launch on login. If this keeps happening, check Login Items in System Settings.
menu.launch_on_login.requires_approval: macOS requires approval for this login item. Turn it on in System Settings > General > Login Items.
menu.unauthorized.title: Ultrakey Needs Accessibility Access
settings.window.title: Ultrakey Settings
settings.seek.heading: Seek
settings.seek.not_configured: Seek has no way to open right now — set a shortcut above, remap a key to Seek, or turn on quick press Caps Lock for Seek on the Presets tab.
settings.seek.execute_on_close: Only show while the remapped key is held
settings.seek.execute_on_close.hint: While this is on, releasing the remapped key confirms the highlighted match and clicks it. Pick a key under "Remap key to Seek:" first — this stays off while that is "-".
settings.seek.quick_press.hint: There's a third way to open Seek: on the Presets tab, set "A brief tap on Caps Lock sends:" to Seek.
settings.seek.change_click_modes_with_mo: Change click modes with modifier keys
If this setting is disabled, modifiers will be applied to the click
settings.hyperkey.heading: Hyperkey
settings.hyperkey.hyper.label: Hyper key source
settings.hyperkey.include_shift: Fold Shift into the hyper combo
settings.hyperkey.include_shift.hint: Applies to hyper only — meh and bleh are unaffected.
settings.hyperkey.meh.label: Meh key source (⌃⌥⇧)
settings.hyperkey.bleh.label: Bleh key source (⌃⌘⇧)
settings.hyperkey.mouse.label: Also apply the hyper combo to these mouse events:
settings.hyperkey.mouse.hint: Turning on Scroll can misfire in apps that reserve ⌘+scroll for zooming.
settings.hyperkey.trackpad.label: Trigger hyper with a trackpad edge swipe:
settings.hyperkey.trackpad.hint: Slide one finger in slightly from the area you pick below; lift it to release hyper.
settings.hyperkey.trackpad.unimplemented: ⚠️ Gesture recognition isn't built yet (F-06, M5). This value is saved but has no effect for now.
settings.hyperkey.trackpad.change_icon: Change menu bar icon while engaged
settings.hyperkey.warning.duplicate: {0} is assigned to more than one combo — hyper takes priority.
settings.hyperkey.warning.unknown_key: The physical keycode for {0} is unknown, so this rule can't be applied.
settings.general.heading: General
settings.general.launch_on_login.why: Ultrakey registers itself as a login item. On macOS 12 it falls back to a LaunchAgent — that path has not been tested on real hardware.
settings.general.launch_on_login.require: macOS has turned off this login item. Turn on Ultrakey in System Settings > General > Login Items so it launches at login.
settings.general.language.hint: Applies immediately. Logs always stay in English, regardless of this setting.
settings.general.auto_update.why: Auto-update is scoped to F-13, M4.
settings.general.hide_menu_bar_icon: Keep the menu bar icon out of sight
settings.general.hide_menu_bar_icon.why: With the icon hidden, relaunch Ultrakey from Finder to get the menu back.
settings.general.menu_bar_icon.why: There's no menu bar icon yet — F-10, M2 phase 2.
settings.general.license.why: Licensing is scoped to F-12, M4.
settings.general.about.settings_absent: No settings file yet — nothing has changed from the defaults.
settings.general.transfer.hint: Export only includes what you've changed from the defaults. Import replaces your settings instead of merging them, and backs up your current settings first.
settings.general.import.done: Imported {0} settings. Previous settings backed up to {1}
settings.general.import.absent_devices: {0} of the imported keyboards aren't connected right now — their settings will apply once you plug them in.
settings.general.event_viewer.hint: Shows the raw key events you send alongside how Ultrakey rewrites and outputs them.
eventviewer.notice.no_permission: Accessibility permission isn't granted, so events can't be observed.
eventviewer.notice.engine_not_running: The remapping engine hasn't started yet.
settings.load_recovered: The settings file was corrupted. A copy was saved to {0} and defaults were loaded.
settings.load_newer_schema: The settings file uses a newer schema (v{0}) than this version. Values are kept as-is, but some may not be understood.

settings.presets.delete_warning: While this is on, nothing sends a backward delete any more.
settings.presets.caps_alias.note: Caps Lock is remapped in the kernel right now so it reports as an ordinary momentary key — that is what makes these presets work. Switch it off under Advanced in the menu bar.

settings.korean.heading: Korean
settings.korean.shift_space: Change input source with Shift + Space
settings.korean.shift_space.hint: Works only while the macOS "Select the previous input source" shortcut is ⌃Space.
settings.korean.han_eng: Change input source with the Han/Eng key
settings.korean.han_eng.hint: Works with the Han/Eng key on a Korean 106-key keyboard. It shares a keycode with the かな key on JIS (Japanese) layouts.
settings.korean.hanja: Convert to Hanja with the Hanja key
settings.korean.hanja.hint: Works with the Hanja key on a Korean 106-key keyboard, and only while a Korean input source is active. It shares a keycode with the 英数 key on JIS layouts.
settings.korean.won_backtick.hint: Applies only while a Korean input source is active, and never intervenes in modifier combinations such as ⌘`.
settings.korean.remote_desktop: Disable Korean key handling in remote desktop clients
settings.korean.remote_desktop.hint: Inside remote desktop, screen sharing and virtual machine windows the keys pass through untouched so the target system's input method can handle them. For clients that are not on the list, use Ignore in the menu bar.
settings.korean.not_working.hint: If this does nothing, another key remapper such as Karabiner-Elements may already be changing the same key below us. Turn its matching rule off and try again.
settings.korean.right_command.hint: To make right command act as ⌃⌥⌘, pick right command as the hyper source in the Hyperkey tab and turn off "Include shift in hyper key" — that combination is exactly ⌃⌥⌘.
preferences.keyboards.keyRemap.emptyList: No key conversions for this device yet.
preferences.keyboards.keyRemap.inherited: These conversions come from “For all devices”. Editing any row here makes this keyboard’s own list; deleting them all turns conversions off for this keyboard only.
preferences.keyboards.keyRemap.duplicate: This key is already remapped in another row.
preferences.keyboards.functionKeys.macos: macOS setting: "Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys"
preferences.keyboards.functionKeys.unver: This destination's usage page has not been verified to work through hidutil.
